name: Repurpose a Winner
subtitle: Your best post, reworked into fresh angles.
summary: Takes one of your top performing standalone posts and rewrites it into new angles and formats (different hook, thread version, contrarian take) so a proven idea works for you more than once. Works on standalone posts, not threads.
howToAsk: Rework this post into new versions.
get: the original's numbers plus 2-3 fresh takes ready to edit and schedule.
launchPrompt: Find my best performing post from the last 30 days and rework it into 2-3 fresh versions with different hooks or formats. If my analytics are still syncing, use my recent posts instead.
